kebab_example: aliyun cms update-agg-task-group --instance-id rw-pq4apob9jm --group-id aggTaskGroup-xxxx --api-version 2024-03-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateAggTaskGroup

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Prometheus instance to which the aggregation task group belongs. The aggregation task reads data from this instance
parameters.help_zh: 聚合任务组所属的 Prometheus 实例ID。聚合任务从这个实例中读取数据
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the aggregation task group
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.example:
groups:
- name: "node.rules"
  interval: "60s"
  rules:
  - record: "node_namespace_pod:kube_pod_info:"
    expr: "max(label_replace(kube_pod_info{job=\"kubernetes-pods-kube-state-metrics\"\
      }, \"pod\", \"$1\", \"pod\", \"(.*)\")) by (node, namespace, pod, cluster)"
parameters.help_en: The configuration of the aggregation task group. Currently, only the RecordingRuleYaml format is supported. The configuration must comply with the RecordingRule format of open source Prometheus
parameters.help_zh: 聚合任务组配置。目前仅支持 “RecordingRuleYaml” 格式，要求符合开源 Prometheus 的 RecordingRule 的格式要求
parameters.name: agg_task_group_config

parameters.help_en: The type of the aggregation task group configuration. The default value is RecordingRuleYaml, which is the RecordingRule format of open source Prometheus
parameters.help_zh: 聚合任务组配置类型，默认 “RecordingRuleYaml”（开源 Prometheus 的 RecordingRule 格式）
parameters.name: agg_task_group_config_type

parameters.help_en: The name of the aggregation task group
parameters.name: agg_task_group_name

parameters.help_en: The cron expression for scheduling when the scheduling mode is set to Cron. For example, \`0/1 \* \* \* \*\` indicates that the task is scheduled every 1 minute, starting from the 0th minute
parameters.help_zh: 调度模式选择“Cron”情况下，具体的调度表达式。例如“0/1 * * * *”，表示从 0 分开始，每隔 1 分钟调度一次
parameters.name: cron_expr

parameters.help_en: The fixed delay for scheduling. Unit: seconds. The default value is 30
parameters.help_zh: 调度的固定延迟时间，单位：秒，默认 30
parameters.name: delay

parameters.help_en: The description of the aggregation task group
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The UNIX timestamp in seconds that indicates the start time of the scheduling
parameters.help_zh: 调度开始时间对应的的秒级时间戳
parameters.name: from_time

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of retries to execute the aggregation task. The default value is 20
parameters.help_zh: 执行聚合任务的最大重试次数，默认 20
parameters.name: max_retries

parameters.help_en: The maximum retry time to execute the aggregation task. Unit: seconds. The default value is 600
parameters.help_zh: 执行聚合任务的最大重试时间，单位：秒，默认 600
parameters.name: max_run_time_in_seconds

parameters.help_en: The dry run configuration. This parameter is not configured by default. The input string must be a valid JSON string
parameters.help_zh: 预检测配置，默认不配置。输入的字符串需要能被正确 JSON 解析
parameters.name: precheck_string

parameters.help_en: The scheduling mode. Valid values: Cron and FixedRate. The default value is FixedRate
parameters.name: schedule_mode

parameters.help_en: The scheduling time expression. Recommended values are \`@s\` and \`@m\`. This expression indicates the granularity at which the scheduling time window is snapped. The default value is \`@m\`
parameters.help_zh: 调度时间表达式，推荐 “@s” 或者 “@m”，表示调度时间窗口对齐的粒度，默认 “@m”
parameters.name: schedule_time_expr

parameters.help_en: The status of the aggregation task group. Valid values: Running and Stopped. The default value is Running
parameters.help_zh: 聚合任务组状态，“Running” 或者 “Stopped”。默认 Running
parameters.name: status

fields.help_en: The key of the resource group tag
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The value of the resource group tag
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tags of the resource group
parameters.name: tags

parameters.help_en: The ID of the target Prometheus instance for the aggregation task group
parameters.help_zh: 聚合任务组的目标 Prometheus 实例ID
parameters.name: target_prometheus_id

parameters.help_en: The UNIX timestamp in seconds that indicates the end time of the scheduling. A value of 0 indicates that the scheduling does not stop
parameters.help_zh: 调度结束时间对应的秒级时间戳，0 表示不停止调度
parameters.name: to_time
